# wgpu-native - prebuilt WebGPU implementation

The `webgpu.h` headers and the prebuilt libraries of wgpu-native
(https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu-native), release `dist/VERSION` (v29.0.1.1). The native WebGPU
backend links it; a player ships it beside the executable.
